subject.name_or_desc: New York City building service workers' union contract (Union 32B-32J), expiring 12:01 a.m. 21 April 1991

context.question: Will there be a building strike when the contract expires?
context.asked_at: Evening of 20 April 1991, New York City
context.setting: Negotiations are to proceed to the last minute — the end of the present contract, the moment set for a strike should negotiations fail. A figure erected for 21 April 1991, 12:01 a.m., NYC, is under discussion; experienced labour-relations opinion in the room holds that management will make a last-minute offer and there will be no strike.

attachments.chart: Figure for 21 April 1991, 00:01, New York City
attachments.key_positions: Mars and the Moon in the 7th house; Gemini on the cusps of both the 6th and 7th houses; Mercury, ruler of the 6th and 7th, in the 4th; Moon separating from Mercury and applying to a square of the Sun, 4.7 degrees distant
